headline: Independent Director re-appointed and Deputy Managing Director requests cessation
why: Key senior leadership departure of Deputy MD who shaped credit architecture and Independent Director re-appointment.

people.name: Lily Vadera
people.background: Over 34 years of experience in Central banking. Retired as Executive Director from RBI in October 2020, where she was in-charge of the Department of Regulation (DoR).

people.name: Kaizad Bharucha
people.background: Association spanning more than three decades; principal architect of the Bank's robust credit architecture.
